scope: Proposition 6.6 (Dispersal and retirement) of the manuscript “Uniform bounds for planar polynomial limit cycles” (preprints/uniform-bounds-for-planar-polynomial-limit-cycles-September-24-2026/uniform-bounds-for-planar-polynomial-limit-cycles-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 143 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8ff8e55372a94e4f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 84. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every coefficient furnished by Proposition 6.5 admits, on each lateral determination, a packet tree using only retained free inputs and ordinary inputs. The numerical outer anchor for an inner kernel is removed at p0 in (6.60); the numerical optimal outer variable is removed at s. When q is large, its optimal variable is removed at σ(l). All transitions have arbitrary fixed exponential accuracy on their full owning fringes. The support is iterated left-finite and all terminal leaves are analytic ordinary germs.
